title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-27
lineage: Source One: Master Reel (Teac A-6100) -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Fostex FR-2LE -> WAV (24bit/96k); Source Two:Reel (Teac A-6100) -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Fostex FR-2LE -> WAV (24bit/96k); Mastering Info:WAV -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16; Reels Baked and Transferred By David Gans; All Mastering By Charlie Miller
source: Source One:SBD -> Shure Line Mixers -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Master Reel (Sony Deck - BASF Tapes - 1/4 Track - 7 1/2 ips); Source Two:SBD -> Shure Line Mixers -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Master Reel (Sony Deck - BASF Tapes - 1/4 Track - 7 1/2 ips) -> Reel (Maxell Tape - 1/4 Track - 7 1/2 ips);

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a legendary 4/27/71 concert with smoking Bertha, Help Me Rhonda and a raw Ron‑Pigpen‑driven Searchin'.
ai_review.review: The recording is a lossless soundboard (SBD) that listeners describe as crystal‑clear and “pure gold,” making the entire show instantly enjoyable.  Fans rave about the energy of Bertha, the playful cover Help Me Rhonda and especially Ron "Pigpen" McKernan’s raw vocal/keyboard addition on Searchin', calling the performance an epic West Coast showcase.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are 5‑star, uniformly praising both the musical performance and the flawless soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Lossless FLAC stream from a SBD transfer; reviewers note crystal‑clear mix with no audible flaws or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A seamless, high‑energy set that blends upbeat covers with classic Dead material, delivering a quintessential West Coast vibe.

band_member_comments.Keys: Ron "Pigpen" McKernan's organ work and lead/backup vocals are highlighted, especially his raw contribution on Searchin'.
